semantics.candidate_rule: Imported content remains inert candidate until apply.
semantics.authority_rule: Valid import does not imply apply authority.
semantics.history_rule: Accepted changes reference exact import execution/source.
semantics.failure_rule: Rejected import never masquerades as accepted canonical state.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.

hard_gates.condition: opening import file mutates live state
rejected import appears in accepted revision
